title: Case Study
scenario: Rohan and Meera start a partnership business, ‘RM Traders’, on 1st April 2024, contributing capital of ₹2,00,000 and ₹1,50,000 respectively. Their partnership deed is silent on the profit-sharing ratio and on interest on capital.
questions: In what ratio will Rohan and Meera share profits, since the deed is silent on this?
Is Meera entitled to interest on her capital? Why or why not?
If the firm earns a profit of ₹1,00,000 in the first year, how much will each partner receive?
